_comment: Jodi voice agent - mid-call API tool (During conversation). Notation as in assess_risk.json. No real secrets in this file.
name: record_update
description: Prepares an update to the mother's or baby's record from what the caller has just said (ASHA visit findings, BP, baby weight, a doctor's new medicine or note, a family member's report, or information from an unknown caller). It does NOT save yet: it returns readback_text and a pending_id. Call it once the caller has finished giving the update and you have already repeated every number and medicine name back to them. Then read readback_text word for word and ask for a clear yes. If the caller corrects anything, call record_update again (the transcript now has the correction) and read the new readback_text. Say a short filler first ('Ondu nimisha...').
response_template: Read this to the caller word for word and wait for a clear yes or a correction: @readback_text
if_it_fails: Sorry, I could not prepare this update just now. Your ASHA will be told, and you can call this number again at any time.

mock_response.readback_text: I heard: Lakshmi, BP 150 over 100, baby weight 2.8 kilograms. Shall I save this?

curl: curl -X POST '{{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}}/tools/record-update' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"caller_phone":"+919800000009","interaction_id":"int_test_002","transcript":"user: Lakshmi nodide, BP 150 over 100, magu 2.8 kg","about_mother_phone":null}'
notes: Contract: docs/contracts.md section 4.4. Source label (asha_measured / doctor_verified / family_reported / unverified) is decided by the backend from the caller phone and transcript (access rules section 7).

about_mother_phone is sent as null; the backend identifies which mother from the transcript (the ASHA says the mother's name). The Sarvam docs do not document LLM-filled body parameters for API tools, so we avoid them here. If a mother cannot be resolved, the backend should say so in readback_text.
Doctor notes: the doctor must say they are a doctor and their name must be confirmed on the call (contract section 7) before this tool is called.

No separate tool is needed for 'reached': when an ASHA-measured or doctor-verified update (with a measurement or medicine) is confirmed, the backend marks the open ticket reached. The ticket closes only after a later non-red assessment.

Free-text updates are accepted too (contracts section 7, anyone may add information): when nothing clinical is said, the caller's latest statement is read back and saved as a note. Notes never mark a ticket reached.
